about: Explore a neon galaxy in your very own battleship in LOVERS IN A DANGEROUS SPACETIME, a thrilling 1- to 4-player couch co-op adventure.
Take control of turrets, lasers, shields and thrusters, using teamwork to triumph over the evil forces of Anti-Love. Deep space is a dangerous place, but you don’t have to face it alone!
Team up with friends (or an AI space-pet) to man the different battle stations. All players fill important roles at all times and nobody gets left behind.
Find and combine powerful space-gems to customize your ship. Each gem gives different abilities, letting you use the right tool for every situation.
